ev.q: Take control of your own starship and blaze your trail in an ever-changing galaxy
The 400-billion star systems of the Milky Way form the vast and dynamic stage
venture out into the unknown across a 1:1 scale universe
there is also Exploring, Exobiology Sampling, On-Foot Combat
in an ever-changing futuristic galactic sandbox
exhilarating space combat and a fully-realised economy for trade
trade, fight, mine, explore, upgrade your equipment, and make money
the real strength of Elite is how deep the rabbit hole can go
This game is a grind and the grind can be very rewarding.
The game is beautiful. Really stunning.
